method: Fixed synthetic corpus scored by the production evaluator through its public boundary (scoreWorldwideVacancy), ordered by the production Search sort (sortResults), retrieved through #686 plans compiled by the production functions and matched by the production shared local filter, with eligibility from the production assessor; compared with a research-only deterministic role-family comparator (option B) under the same envelope. No AI comparator was run (see limits).

labels.meaning: Fixture-author expectations written from the synthetic profile and posting text. Not human-reviewed labels, not a panel, not hiring truth.
labels.grades: relevant > adjacent > not_relevant; null = author could not label (reported, excluded from graded counts)

currentEvaluator.versionConstant: none exists in the evaluator; pinned by base commit plus the byte-compared outputs below

resourceEnvelope.description: Identical for both evaluators: the same synthetic profile and the same title/description text per case, one synchronous in-process call per (case, profile), no network, no model, no provider, no file I/O, no cache, no retries.
resourceEnvelope.cost: not_applicable: no metered service is called
resourceEnvelope.latency: measured in evaluation.test.ts with performance.now() and written only to OVR_LATENCY_OUT when set; NOT committed, because wall-clock time is not deterministic and would break the byte comparison
